answer: Sybil resistance fails when trust pools, so price collusion as cut-flow. Rebuild the trust graph each epoch and seat juries only across computed min-cuts: no jury reachable from one sponsor below 0.3 flow units. Forty aliases in one island carry one key's budget — inflow never exceeds the cut. Fake trust is a plume drifting like a zephyr until the audit tide: correlated flow forfeits 5% of bonded stake per node, leaving attackers on a ledge with nothing to spend. Cedar audits sample 10% of edges; a forged edge forfeits its stake. Verify cuts once, sample the rest.
